name: Mavus Talnarith

abilities.name: Flare
abilities.description: A basic ranged attack that does minor flame damage.

abilities.name: Heat Wave
abilities.description: Mavus releases fire along the ground in the direction it is facing. This attack does moderate flame damage to all players hit by it. This spell can be interrupted to set the enemy off balance or simply avoided.

abilities.name: Fire Runes
abilities.description: Mavus shoots two fireballs in the air which form two fire runes when they land. The runes do moderate flame damage over time to all enemies within the red circles and should be avoided. Players should be prepared to move as soon as the attack casts as one rune will always be cast on top of you.

abilities.name: Volcanic Rune
abilities.description: Mavus casts a blue fire rune on the floor, indicated by a circular AoE, dealing high flame damage and knocking back if triggered.

abilities.name: Degeneration
abilities.description: Mavus casts a damage over time dealing spell on a player that heals him over time.

abilities.name: Ice comet
abilities.description: Mavus casts an Ice Comet on a player, dealing frost damage and stunning in a area after a delay, leaving a ground area dealing damage over time. The primary target also has a damage over time effect on them.

summary: Mavus Talnarith is a Breton and former member of the Mages Guild. He is the champion of the eighth round at the Dragonstar Arena, and is assisted by the Dwarven Fire Centurions and Dwarven Ice Centurions as well as Charged Centurions in veteran mode. Hiath the Battlemaster will summon him when he reaches 50% health.
